column2: Question about deadline and process for reconciling corporate card expenses
column3: Hi, I wanted to clarify the process and deadline for reconciling expenses on my corporate card. When exactly do I need to upload receipts and match them to transactions? Also, what happens if I’m missing a receipt? Is there a penalty for being late? Thanks.
column8: 28/Jul/26 07:00 PM;Samir Patel;Hi Jenna, please see the Corporate Card Usage > Expense Reconciliation and Receipts policy. All cardholders must reconcile expenses within 7 days after the statement closes (statements close on the 25th). Receipts go in FinTrak and must be matched to each transaction. If you’re missing a receipt over $50, you’ll need to provide a written explanation and get your supervisor’s sign-off. Late reconciliation can result in a $25 payroll deduction. Let us know if you need more info!

column2: Question about maternity leave policy details
column3: Hi, I wanted to clarify the maternity leave policy at Larkspur Freight. How many weeks of paid leave are available, and does it differ between the UK and US offices? Also, what is the process for submitting a maternity leave request?
column8: 02/Jul/26 06:30 PM;Megan Patel;Hi Jessica, for eligible employees, we offer 16 weeks of paid maternity leave at 100% base salary. In the UK, after those 16 weeks, statutory maternity pay kicks in (up to 39 weeks total, at £172.48/week or 90% of your average weekly earnings, whichever is lower). In the US, paid leave is capped at 12 weeks, with an optional 4 weeks unpaid. All requests should go through the HR portal. Let me know if you need the link!
